entries.title: Static Heavy-Shoulder Four-Plantigrade-Paw Bear
entries.description: One newly authored whole static stylised quadrupedal bear-like animal. A continuous lower tapered muzzle and broad forehead run into a short thick descending neck and a massive high shoulder, deep long belly and rounded rear rump. Four complete thick differently shaped limbs meet the ground through long wide plantigrade-looking integral paws, rather than a toy seated butt and dangling padded arms or ape knuckles. Small rounded upright ears, two recessed-position whole eye details, a broad dark muzzle nose and a very short rear tail complete the entire silhouette. No imported toy or animal geometry. One whole model zero scenes. No exact bear species, fur simulation, biological scale, behavior, locomotion, foot biomechanics, rig or animation claim.

entries.title: Static Bull Head and Two Hoof Minotaur
entries.description: One independently authored whole static minotaur-inspired fantasy character: a broad upright chest and covered hip stand above two bent legs ending in whole actually cleft hooves. Two long relaxed arms end in blunt stylized hands. A thick neck carries a complete broad bull-like head with descending blunt dark muzzle, lateral ears, two full curved outward-upturned horns and seated dark eyes. A short hanging tail has a widened dark tip. All proportions, sections and limb paths are newly drawn as one coherent bipedal fantasy figure, not an extracted cow head pasted onto an old person or a recoloured centaur with two legs removed. Three opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up, full horizontal envelope centred at the two finite hoof soles. Integral dark lower-torso wrap covers the hips; no weapons or extra costume props. Static fictional art only, not anatomical realism, gait, strength, behavioral or safety functionality. Fine articulated fingers, rigging, animation, interaction and collision are not produced or verified and are outside delivery.

entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed socket-wrench-style exterior, laid on its full low body facets. That socket is a continuous closed thick shell with a true front six-sided cavity, full internal step and rear smaller square passage, rather than a black painted circle or solid cylinder. A separate full dark grip pad belongs to the long tail. All whole numerical geometry is newly authored, not an adjustable wrench with its movable jaw renamed or the two-sided V-jaw tap frame reduced. entries.title: Fixed Roller Pillow and Fanned Bobbin Lace Frame
entries.description: One newly authored complete roller-pillow lace-working apparatus in a fixed illustrative pose. Two long finite feet and cross rails carry two end standards, a continuous transverse shaft and a thick softly rounded horizontal roll pillow. A small pin field rises from the crown; twelve continuous solid thread lines fan down toward complete turned wooden bobbins, each with a neck, shoulder and long grip. A low front catch board belongs to the same support frame. Unlike the old seamed pin cushion this is not a cushion-and-loose-pins kit: the roller, bearing frame and suspended connected bobbins define one whole apparatus. Unlike the full floor loom there is no fore/aft warp-cloth pair, heddle castle, reed beater or treadle system. All visible geometry newly authored, no extracted old cushion or loom mesh. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up and horizontal full-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete static prop zero scenes. Thread and pin layout is an illustrative frozen arrangement, not a verified lace pattern, weaving sequence, tension equilibrium, rotating mechanism, ergonomic tool or safe functional apparatus. No cloth, rigging, animation, interaction, sharpness or performance claim.

entries.title: Fixed Slotted Tube and Low Trough Shaker Frame
entries.description: One independently authored complete bamboo-style slotted-tube shaker frame in a fixed pose. A continuous low trough with two integral side walls and a finite flat sole carries two lower locating stems. Two separately authored stopped-bottom hollow tubes rise above it; each has a real deep inner cavity and a long side-open upper half-shell rather than a simple open circular pipe mouth. A full tall side-post and top-crosspiece frame, central upright and short fixed upper suspension ties hold the complete illustrated assembly. Each tube is one continuous closed material boundary from bottom disc through outer wall, variable-height open edge and complete inner wall; no painted opening. Unlike the bound panflute the main tubes are not tied into a mouth-aligned bank; unlike the suspended tubular-bell frame they have closed bottoms, deep longitudinal side openings and lower stems seated in a shared low trough, without a damper or pedal. All visible coordinates new, no old pipe or rack mesh extracted. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and horizontal full-bounds-centred ground datum. One static whole instrument-shaped prop zero scenes. Angklung-inspired exterior only, not a historically exact example: no acoustic tuning, sound, shaking clearance, suspension behaviour, playable mechanism, joint travel, material authenticity, load, fabrication or safety claim.
